criteria.resampling: area; no crop, alignment, temporal interpolation or registration
criteria.intensity: gray uint8, explicit full output range; input declared range or yuv420p limited fallback
criteria.equivalence: Neighbor differences below2gray MAE or insufficient improvement do not establish a shift.
criteria.scope_limit: Downsampled luminance correspondence, not exact pixels, chroma-only errors, small text readability or audio.
